senses.sense_definition: A medical device designed to assist or control human breathing by providing oxygen or moving air into the lungs.

examples.text: The patient was connected to a medical <w>respirator</w> to help him breathe during surgery. Medical staff monitored the patient on a medical <w>respirator</w> throughout the night. Medical staff monitored the patient on a medical <w>respirator</w> throughout the night.
Doctors placed the injured athlete on a <w>respirator</w> after his oxygen levels dropped rapidly.

senses.sense_definition: A protective face mask fitted with a filter to prevent the inhalation of harmful dust, fumes, or airborne particles.

examples.text: Every worker must wear a protective <w>respirator</w> when painting cars in the enclosed spray booth. Every worker must wear a protective <w>respirator</w> when working in dusty conditions. Every worker must wear a protective <w>respirator</w> when working in dusty conditions.
Any N95 <w>respirator</w> is designed to filter out ninety-five percent of small airborne particles.
